name: Delectatio Morosa: A Conclave Visual Novel
source:
The conclave is over: you are still a manager.

Delectatio Morosa: A Conclave Visual Novel is a managing sim fan project.

Play as Dean Thomas Cardinal Lawrence as he prepares for All Saints' Day. After the conclave, the Vatican only has one week to prepare for the upcoming celebrations and the responsibility to manage his Curia members, and growing feelings for them, falls upon you.

[From [url=https://sneckoil.itch.io/delectatio-morosa]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
秘密会议结束了：你仍然是经理。

Delectatio Morosa: A Conclave Visual Novel是一个管理模拟粉丝项目。

扮演迪恩·托马斯·红衣主教劳伦斯，为万圣节做准备。秘密会议结束后，梵蒂冈只有一周的时间为即将到来的庆祝活动做准备，管理教廷成员的责任以及对他们日益增长的感情就落到了你的身上。

[来自[url=https://sneckoil.itch.io/delectatio-morosa]itch.io[/url]]
